email_subject: Application - EU Policy Content Writer / Digital Content Specialist
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the EU Policy Content Writer / Digital Content Specialist position at ICF Next. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to EU communication projects and multi-country campaigns.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I write keyword-targeted blog content, manage on-page SEO, and build WordPress sites. My project mirook.com demonstrates my ability to create digital-friendly content and apply SEO best practices, including structured data and entity optimization, to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. I am skilled in conducting research, monitoring developments, and producing accurate, engaging content.

I am based in Belgium and have the right to work here. I am eager to bring my technical and creative skills to your team and help shape impactful narratives for EU institutions.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to ICF Next.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the EU Policy Content Writer / Digital Content Specialist position at ICF Next. With a unique blend of digital marketing expertise, technical SEO skills, and a passion for clear, engaging communication, I am confident in my ability to contribute to your EU communication projects and multi-country campaigns.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed my skills in writing keyword-targeted blog content, managing on-page SEO, and building WordPress sites. This experience has taught me the importance of adapting content to different platforms and audiences, a skill directly applicable to the diverse formats required for EU policy communication.

I am particularly drawn to ICF Next's mission of working at the intersection of strategy, creativity, and public impact. I am eager to apply my research skills to understand EU policies and political developments, and to translate complex information into clear, compelling narratives. My background in computer science and front-end development gives me a technical edge in creating digital-friendly content and collaborating with digital teams. I am also highly organized, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced, multicultural environments.

Based in Belgium, I have the legal right to work and am ready to start immediately. I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects that shape policies across Europe.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit ICF Next.

Sincerely,

# Baver Ok
Digital Content & SEO Specialist
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Digital content specialist with a strong foundation in SEO, web design, and digital communication. Experienced in writing and editing engaging, keyword-targeted content for online audiences, and in applying SEO best practices to improve visibility and performance. Skilled in researching and synthesizing information to produce accurate, clear, and audience-appropriate content across multiple formats. Proven ability to manage content projects end-to-end, from research and writing to publication and performance analysis. Based in Belgium, with the right to work. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch at B1 level.

## Core Skills
- Content Writing & Editing: SEO blog writing, editorial content, web content, newsletters, social media content, press releases (basic)
- SEO & Digital: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD, entity optimization, GEO & AEO, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs
- Content Management & CMS: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, content uploads, page updates, social media integration
- Research & Analysis: desk research, monitoring web performance, identifying content opportunities, using analytics to refine content
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

- Track and analyze content performance using SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console to inform content strategy

### Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment, demonstrating strong organizational skills

### Front-End Developer — ViviDoctor (Belgium), 2018–2019
- Developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application (AngularJS, JavaScript), ensuring a user-friendly experience

## Projects

- Designed and built a multi-page WordPress site (Elementor, Astra) for a Belgian youth chess champion, including full site structure and on-page SEO

- Ran iterative SEO/GEO audits, measurably raising the site's search-health score
